summary: Capture safety emergencies fast, then grow ticket size with panel upgrades, generators and EV chargers sold on load, outages and safety. Use with the Miles Master Template (deploy logic, ZIP scoring, customer journey).

sections.title: Intro
lines: Capture safety emergencies fast, then grow ticket size with panel upgrades, generators and EV chargers sold on load, outages and safety. Use with the Miles Master Template (deploy logic, ZIP scoring, customer journey).

sections.title: 1. At a glance
lines: Emergency (outage, sparking, breaker trips) + upgrade projects
Panel / service upgrade; whole-home standby generator; EV charger install
Inspection → panel upgrade → generator or EV charger → whole-home surge protection
Federal 30C home EV charger credit ended for chargers placed in service after June 30, 2026

sections.title: 2. Seasonality by region
lines: Hurricane season Jun 1–Nov 30; sell generators Mar–May before it
Pre-season generator push; post-storm repairs and inspections
Ice storms Dec–Feb; holiday lighting Nov–Dec
Generators before winter; heat-load panel issues
Generators + surge protection; EV and remodel panel upgrades year-round
Panel capacity for AC, solar-ready panels
Panel upgrades tied to kitchens, hot tubs, EVs, home offices

sections.title: 3. Location signals (add to ZIP score)
lines: Median year built: older homes often have smaller panels or outdated wiring; pre-1980 homes get the safety-inspection front door.
Outage frequency and storm exposure (hurricane, ice storm) for generator ZIPs.
Natural gas availability (generator fuel) vs propane.
EV adoption and newer high-income ZIPs for charger + panel bundles.
Home value: generators and service upgrades are premium tickets.

sections.title: 4. Demographics and audiences
lines: Emergency buyer: any homeowner; trust and speed.
Generator buyer: homeowner 45–75, higher income, work-from-home or medical-equipment needs, in outage-prone ZIPs.
EV / remodel buyer: 30–55, higher income, newer vehicles, renovating.
Audiences: past customers in generator ZIPs before storm season; EV owners and home-improvement interests; realtor/inspection referrals for older homes.

Load with the Audience framework in the Master Template. Emergency segments get no income or homeowner filter and start at 25+; planned segments use the filters below. Ages are starting points: Miles tightens them from closed-won CRM data after 30 booked jobs.
Search: panel upgrade, 200 amp; observe Homeowners
past service-call customers in older homes
median >= $100K or median home value top third of service area
Search: whole home generator; HHI bid +, observe Top 30%
Search: EV charger installation; in-market EV segments
Exclude in every segment: customers from the last 12 months (except retention campaigns), open leads and estimates, employees, out-of-area ZIPs.

sections.title: 5. Offer stack
lines: $[X] off panel upgrade; or EV charger + panel bundle
Whole-home standby generator with financing from $[X]/mo; $[X] off before [storm-season date]
Whole-home surge protection, dedicated circuits, lighting
Annual generator maintenance plan; electrical safety check
Same-day for outages, burning smells, sparking; no discount

sections.title: 6. Channels and campaign build
lines: Search + LSA: split emergency, panel upgrade, generator, EV charger, lighting.
Negatives: jobs, apprenticeship, DIY, portable generators (unless sold), parts.
Meta: generator pre-season creative with real install photos; EV charger creative to EV-interest audiences.
Landing pages per project: panel upgrade, generator, EV charger; each with financing and permit/licensing proof.

sections.title: 7. Triggers Miles watches
lines: Named storm or ice storm forecast
Generator inspection/maintenance push to existing owners; emergency budget up
"Never again" generator campaign in affected ZIPs (tasteful, 3–7 days after)

sections.title: 8. After the job and retention
lines: Every service call: offer the safety inspection or surge protection; record panel size and age in CRM.
Generator installs: maintenance plan at install; annual service reminder.
Thank-you coupon toward next service; honest review ask to everyone.

sections.title: 9. Compliance and watch-outs
lines: License, permit, and inspection claims must be true; show license number where required.
Don't advertise the federal EV charger credit for installs after June 30, 2026; check state and utility rebates.
Post-outage ads: no fear exploitation or price-gouging language.

sections.title: 10. Deploy checklist
lines: ☐ Confirm services (generators and brands, EV chargers, panels, commercial)
☐ Score ZIPs on housing age, outage exposure, gas availability, income
☐ Load inspection, panel, generator, EV offers with real financing
☐ Build Search + LSA by service; project landing pages
☐ Turn on speed-to-lead, estimate follow-up (long-cycle generator quotes), post-job and maintenance-plan automations
Sources: 30C EV charger credit end date (EnergySage) · Atlantic hurricane season dates and panel upgrades for generators · generator demand in hurricane and ice-storm areas (Builder)
